properties.summary: Increased default client timeout from 1500ms to 5000ms to allow upstream microservices to tolerate regional transit spikes without aborting.
properties.rationale: Prior 1500ms limit triggered cascading 504 drops whenever AWS transit gateway suffered sub-second latency jitter.

properties.author: alex_eng
properties.discussion: @alex_eng: 'Under load tests, 1.5s is too tight when Redis cache misses occur. 5000ms gives downstream services enough runway.' Approved by @sarah_lead.

properties.root_cause: Aggressive 1500ms timeout caused 40% of user checkout requests to abort prematurely during peak sale load.

properties.summary: Completely deactivated local process token caching in favor of strict remote Redis validation on every request.
properties.rationale: High-concurrency race condition allowed revoked tenant tokens to remain valid for up to 60 seconds on worker nodes.

nodes.label: PR #205: Disable In-Memory Session Cache to Prevent Token Replay

properties.author: priya_sec
properties.discussion: @priya_sec: 'Memory cache has an asynchronous invalidation gap. A revoked token can still authenticate requests on node 3. Disabling local cache until distributed pub/sub sync is built.'

nodes.label: INC-142: Revoked Admin Session Leak Vulnerability

properties.root_cause: Local worker memory cache served cached permissions for 45 seconds after user permissions were revoked in IAM.

nodes.label: Cap Retries to 3 with Truncated Exponential Jitter

properties.summary: Enforced strict maximum of 3 retries with full jitter backoff.
properties.rationale: Prevented downstream thundering herd problem when billing webhooks fail during partner outages.

nodes.label: PR #310: Implement Jittered Retry Policy for Webhook Dispatch

properties.author: david_sre
properties.discussion: @david_sre: 'Uncapped retries DDoS'ed our own downstream notification cluster. 3 retries with exponential backoff captures 98% of transient failures without causing a thundering herd.'
